ex.en: Allan was lucky and passed the tax accountant examination.
ex.zh: 艾倫運氣很好，考過了稅務師考試。

ex.en: If he studied hard, he would pass the test.
ex.zh: 如果他用功讀書，就會通過考試。

ex.en: Excuse me, would you mind passing me the sugar?
ex.zh: 不好意思，可以把糖遞給我嗎？

ex.en: Please pass the salt.
ex.zh: 請把鹽遞給我。

pass.en: to give something to someone by hand

ex.en: Time passes quickly when we're doing something we like.
ex.zh: 做喜歡的事時，時間過得特別快。

ex.en: Three years passed before we met again.
ex.zh: 三年過去了，我們才再次見面。

pass.en: to go by, as time does

ex.en: I'm sorry to hear that your father passed away.
ex.zh: 聽到你父親過世的消息，我很難過。

ex.en: My grandmother passed away last year.
ex.zh: 我奶奶去年過世了。

pass.en: to die, said in a polite way

ex.en: Check that your username and password are written correctly.
ex.zh: 請檢查使用者名稱和密碼是否輸入正確。

ex.en: Could you tell me the Wi-Fi password, please?
ex.zh: 可以告訴我 Wi-Fi 密碼嗎？

ex.en: The password isn't correct, so try again. Passwords are case-sensitive.
ex.zh: 密碼不正確，請再試一次。密碼有區分大小寫。

password.en: a secret word that lets you use a computer or account

ex.en: Besides being an actress, she was a famous painter.
ex.zh: 她不只是演員，也是一位知名的畫家。

ex.en: Painters like Picasso are rare.
ex.zh: 像畢卡索這樣的畫家很少見。

ex.en: You are a good painter, aren't you?
ex.zh: 你是個很棒的畫家，不是嗎？

painter.en: a person who makes pictures with colors

ex.en: We hired a painter to paint the living room.
ex.zh: 我們請了油漆工來粉刷客廳。

ex.en: The painters will finish the walls by Friday.
ex.zh: 油漆工會在星期五前把牆漆好。

painter.en: a person whose job is to put color on walls and buildings

ex.en: The restaurant offers free parking for patrons.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳提供顧客免費停車。

ex.en: Library patrons can borrow up to ten books.
ex.zh: 圖書館的讀者最多可以借十本書。

patron.en: a person who regularly uses a shop or restaurant

ex.en: She is a well-known patron of the arts.
ex.zh: 她是知名的藝術贊助人。

ex.en: The museum thanked its patrons for their support.
ex.zh: 博物館感謝贊助者的支持。

patron.en: a person who gives money to support an artist or cause

ex.en: He never brings the paycheck home.
ex.zh: 他從來不把薪水帶回家。

ex.en: I get my paycheck on the fifth of every month.
ex.zh: 我每個月五號領薪水。

ex.en: Many people live paycheck to paycheck.
ex.zh: 很多人都過著月光族的生活。

paycheck.en: the money a worker receives for their job

ex.en: I bought two packets of pistachios.
ex.zh: 我買了兩包開心果。

ex.en: She opened a packet of biscuits.
ex.zh: 她打開了一包餅乾。

ex.en: I'd like a packet of aspirin.
ex.zh: 我要一盒阿斯匹靈。

packet.en: a small box or bag containing a product

ex.en: I want to buy a pair of pants.
ex.zh: 我想買一條褲子。

ex.en: I don't need anything... just a new pair of pants.
ex.zh: 我什麼都不需要……只要一條新褲子。

ex.en: When I was little, I would only wear pants.
ex.zh: 我小時候只穿褲子。

pant.en: a piece of clothing that covers each leg from the waist down

ex.en: He ran too fast; when he stopped, he was panting.
ex.zh: 他跑得太快，停下來時氣喘吁吁。

ex.en: The dog was panting in the heat.
ex.zh: 那隻狗熱得直喘氣。

pant.en: to breathe quickly with short breaths, for example after running

ex.en: She doesn't have as much patience as you do.
ex.zh: 她沒有你那麼有耐心。

ex.en: Mastering a foreign language calls for patience.
ex.zh: 精通一種外語需要耐心。

ex.en: A lot of our mistakes come from a lack of patience.
ex.zh: 我們很多錯誤都源於缺乏耐心。

patience.en: the ability to wait calmly without getting angry

payroll.zh: 員工名冊（on the payroll 受僱）

ex.en: We have 50 people on the payroll.
ex.zh: 我們有五十名員工。

ex.en: She has been on the payroll for ten years.
ex.zh: 她已經在公司任職十年了。

payroll.en: a list of the people employed by a company

ex.en: Payroll is processed on the 25th of each month.
ex.zh: 薪資在每個月 25 號處理。

ex.en: The payroll department handles salary questions.
ex.zh: 薪資部門負責處理薪水相關問題。

payroll.en: the total money paid to workers, or the work of paying them

ex.en: A crowd of people gathered to see the parade.
ex.zh: 一大群人聚集來看遊行。

ex.en: I caught sight of a parade on my way home.
ex.zh: 我在回家的路上看到一場遊行。

ex.en: The city holds a parade every New Year.
ex.zh: 這座城市每年新年都會舉辦遊行。

parade.en: a public event where people walk or drive through the streets

ex.en: The company applied for a patent on the new design.
ex.zh: 公司為新設計申請了專利。

ex.en: The patent expires next year.
ex.zh: 這項專利明年到期。

patent.en: an official right to be the only one who makes or sells an invention

ex.en: He patented his invention in 2020.
ex.zh: 他在 2020 年為他的發明取得專利。

ex.en: You should patent your idea before showing it to investors.
ex.zh: 給投資人看之前，你應該先為你的點子申請專利。

patent.en: to get an official right to be the only one who makes an invention

ex.en: The invoice is payable within 30 days.
ex.zh: 這張發票須在三十天內付款。

ex.en: Rent is payable on the first day of each month.
ex.zh: 房租在每月一號支付。

ex.en: Please make the check payable to ABC Company.
ex.zh: 支票抬頭請寫 ABC 公司。

ex.en: Checks should be made payable to the hotel.
ex.zh: 支票抬頭應開給飯店。

payable.en: used to show the person or company a check should be paid to

ex.en: I use a frying pan at least once a day.
ex.zh: 我每天至少用一次平底鍋。

ex.en: Don't leave dirty pots and pans on the stove; wash them.
ex.zh: 別把髒鍋子放在爐子上，去洗乾淨。

ex.en: Heat some oil in a pan.
ex.zh: 在鍋裡把油燒熱。

pan.en: a round metal container used for cooking on a stove

ex.en: The movie was panned by critics.
ex.zh: 這部電影被影評人狠批。

ex.en: Critics panned the new phone.
ex.zh: 評論家給這款新手機很差的評價。

ex.en: Did you get the parcel I sent you?
ex.zh: 你收到我寄給你的包裹了嗎？

ex.en: The address on this parcel is wrong.
ex.zh: 這個包裹上的地址寫錯了。

ex.en: The parcel arrived faster than I thought it would.
ex.zh: 包裹比我想的還早到。

parcel.en: something wrapped in paper to be sent by mail

ex.en: Kids love pasta in tomato sauce.
ex.zh: 小朋友都喜歡番茄醬義大利麵。

ex.en: Do you eat pasta?
ex.zh: 你吃義大利麵嗎？

ex.en: There's often rice or pasta for lunch.
ex.zh: 午餐常常是飯或義大利麵。

pasta.en: an Italian food made from flour and water in various shapes

ex.en: May I use your ink pad?
ex.zh: 可以借用一下你的印台嗎？

ex.en: Put a mouse pad under your mouse.
ex.zh: 在滑鼠下面放一個滑鼠墊。

pad.en: a soft piece of material used to protect, clean or hold ink

ex.en: Keep a pad and pen by the phone.
ex.zh: 在電話旁邊放一本便條本和一支筆。

ex.en: She wrote the number on a pad of paper.
ex.zh: 她把號碼寫在便條紙上。

pad.en: sheets of paper joined together at one edge for writing

ex.en: Can you paraphrase the question in simpler words?
ex.zh: 你可以用比較簡單的話把問題重說一次嗎？

ex.en: Try to paraphrase the article in your own words.
ex.zh: 試著用你自己的話改寫這篇文章。

paraphrase.en: to say something again using different words

ex.en: Write a short paraphrase of this paragraph.
ex.zh: 把這一段改寫成簡短的版本。

ex.en: This is a paraphrase, not a direct quote.
ex.zh: 這是改述，不是直接引用。

paraphrase.en: a statement that says something again using different words

ex.en: Is there a paperback edition of this book?
ex.zh: 這本書有平裝版嗎？

ex.en: I bought a paperback at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場買了一本平裝書。

ex.en: The paperback is much cheaper than the hardcover.
ex.zh: 平裝版比精裝版便宜很多。

paperback.en: a book with a soft thin cover

ex.en: From childhood I dreamed of being a pastry cook.
ex.zh: 我從小就夢想當糕點師傅。

ex.en: This bakery sells delicious French pastries.
ex.zh: 這家麵包店賣很好吃的法式糕點。

pastry.en: a small sweet baked food made from flour and fat

ex.en: Roll the pastry into a rectangle.
ex.zh: 把麵糰擀成長方形。

ex.en: Bake the pie until the pastry is golden.
ex.zh: 把派烤到酥皮呈金黃色。

pastry.en: a mixture of flour and fat used to make pies and tarts

ex.en: This pamphlet is free of charge.
ex.zh: 這本小冊子是免費的。

ex.en: The pamphlet explains how to apply for a visa.
ex.zh: 這本小冊子說明如何申請簽證。

pamphlet.en: a thin book with information about a subject

ex.en: It was only a partial success.
ex.zh: 那只算是部分成功。

ex.en: We received a partial refund for the cancelled tour.
ex.zh: 取消的行程我們拿到了部分退款。

ex.en: There will be a partial road closure this weekend.
ex.zh: 這個週末道路將部分封閉。

ex.en: I'm partial to dark chocolate.
ex.zh: 我特別喜歡黑巧克力。

ex.en: A judge should never be partial.
ex.zh: 法官絕不應該偏袒任何一方。

partial.en: liking something very much, or treating one side better

ex.en: She works as a paralegal at a law firm.
ex.zh: 她在律師事務所擔任律師助理。

ex.en: The paralegal prepared all the documents for the case.
ex.zh: 律師助理準備了這個案子的所有文件。

paralegal.en: a person who helps lawyers with their work but is not a lawyer

ex.en: You're partially correct.
ex.zh: 你說對了一部分。

ex.en: The road is partially closed for repairs.
ex.zh: 這條路因施工部分封閉。

ex.en: The project was partially funded by the government.
ex.zh: 這個專案有部分經費由政府提供。

ex.en: The meetings of the parliament are public.
ex.zh: 國會的會議是公開的。

ex.en: The President cannot disband the Parliament.
ex.zh: 總統不得解散國會。

parliament.en: the group of people who make the laws of a country

par.zh: on (a) par with：與…同等、不相上下

ex.en: Our prices are on par with our competitors'.
ex.zh: 我們的價格和競爭對手差不多。

ex.en: His skills are on a par with senior engineers.
ex.zh: 他的能力和資深工程師不相上下。

par.en: equal in level or quality to

par.zh: below par / not up to par：低於標準；身體不太舒服

ex.en: His work has been below par lately.
ex.zh: 他最近的工作表現不如水準。

ex.en: I'm feeling a bit below par today.
ex.zh: 我今天身體有點不舒服。

par.en: lower than the usual standard, or not feeling well

ex.en: The bonds were issued at par.
ex.zh: 這些債券按面額發行。

ex.en: The par value of each share is ten dollars.
ex.zh: 每股面額為十元。

par.en: the face value printed on a share or bond

parameter.zh: 參數；（限定範圍的）條件、界限

ex.en: You can change the parameters in the settings menu.
ex.zh: 你可以在設定選單裡更改參數。

ex.en: We must work within the parameters of the budget.
ex.zh: 我們必須在預算的範圍內做事。

parameter.en: a limit or setting that controls how something works

ex.en: All that hard work finally had a big payoff.
ex.zh: 所有的努力終於有了豐厚的回報。

ex.en: The payoff from this investment may take years.
ex.zh: 這項投資可能要好幾年才看得到回報。

payoff.en: a good result that you get from effort

ex.en: The parliamentary election will be held in May.
ex.zh: 國會選舉將在五月舉行。

ex.en: The UK has a parliamentary system.
ex.zh: 英國採行議會制度。

parliamentary.en: related to the group that makes the laws of a country

payout.zh: 支付款項；（保險）理賠金、（股利）配發

ex.en: The insurance payout covered all the repairs.
ex.zh: 保險理賠金支付了所有維修費用。

ex.en: Shareholders received a large payout this year.
ex.zh: 股東今年獲得大筆配息。

payout.en: a large amount of money paid to someone

ex.en: Watching TV is a passive activity.
ex.zh: 看電視是一種被動的活動。

ex.en: He has a passive character.
ex.zh: 他的個性很被動。

ex.en: It is clearly shown in Johnson's investigation that passive smoking is very harmful.
ex.zh: Johnson 的調查清楚顯示，二手菸非常有害。

passive.en: accepting what happens without taking action

ex.en: Change this sentence into the passive voice.
ex.zh: 把這個句子改成被動語態。

ex.en: The passive voice is common in formal reports.
ex.zh: 被動語態在正式報告中很常見。

passive.en: in grammar, showing that the subject receives the action

ex.en: The payback period for the solar panels is about six years.
ex.zh: 這些太陽能板的回收期大約是六年。

ex.en: We expect a quick payback on this investment.
ex.zh: 我們預期這筆投資能很快回本。

payback.en: the money you get back from an investment

ex.en: He said it was payback for what I did last year.
ex.zh: 他說這是對我去年所作所為的報復。

ex.en: This is payback for all the times you laughed at me.
ex.zh: 這是你每次笑我的報應。

payback.en: something bad done to someone because of what they did

ex.en: Women are still fighting for pay parity.
ex.zh: 女性仍在爭取同工同酬。

ex.en: The two currencies are now close to parity.
ex.zh: 這兩種貨幣的匯率現在接近一比一。

ex.en: The new model achieves parity with its rivals in features.
ex.zh: 新機型的功能已與競爭對手不相上下。

parity.en: the state of being equal, especially in money or status

ex.en: The two companies signed a pact to share technology.
ex.zh: 兩家公司簽訂了技術共享協定。

ex.en: We made a pact to save money together.
ex.zh: 我們約好一起存錢。

pact.en: a formal agreement between people or countries

ex.en: Bee stings can be very painful.
ex.zh: 被蜜蜂螫到可能會非常痛。

ex.en: My knee is still painful after the fall.
ex.zh: 跌倒之後我的膝蓋還是很痛。

painful.en: causing a feeling of hurt in the body

ex.en: The truth can be more painful than a lie.
ex.zh: 真相可能比謊言更傷人。

ex.en: There's nothing more painful than losing one's child.
ex.zh: 沒有什麼比失去孩子更痛苦的事了。

ex.en: Tiny particles in the air can cause cancer.
ex.zh: 空氣中的微粒可能引發癌症。

ex.en: Dust particles can cause allergies.
ex.zh: 灰塵微粒可能引起過敏。

particle.en: a very small piece of something

ex.en: A glass partition separates the two offices.
ex.zh: 一道玻璃隔板把兩間辦公室隔開。

ex.en: We put up a partition to create a small meeting room.
ex.zh: 我們加裝隔板，隔出一間小會議室。

partition.en: a thin wall or screen that divides a room

partition.zh: 隔開、分割（空間；硬碟分割）

ex.en: The large room was partitioned into three offices.
ex.zh: 那個大房間被隔成三間辦公室。

ex.en: You can partition the hard drive into two sections.
ex.zh: 你可以把硬碟分割成兩個磁區。

partition.en: to divide a space or a computer disk into separate parts

ex.en: There's a patch on the knee of his jeans.
ex.zh: 他的牛仔褲膝蓋上有個補丁。

ex.en: Be careful, there are icy patches on the road.
ex.zh: 小心，路上有一塊塊結冰的地方。

patch.en: a piece of cloth that covers a hole, or a small area

ex.en: The company released a security patch.
ex.zh: 公司發佈了一個安全性修補程式。

ex.en: Install the latest patch to fix the bug.
ex.zh: 安裝最新的修補程式來修正這個錯誤。

patch.en: a piece of code that fixes problems in a computer program

ex.en: He has patched up the hole in the wall.
ex.zh: 他把牆上的洞補好了。

ex.en: I need to patch the hole in my jacket.
ex.zh: 我得把外套上的破洞補起來。

patch.en: to mend a hole by covering it with a piece of material

ex.en: Let's patch up our argument.
ex.zh: 我們別吵了，和好吧。

ex.en: They finally patched up their friendship.
ex.zh: 他們終於重修舊好。

patch.en: to end a quarrel and become friends again

ex.en: Paramilitary groups controlled the area for years.
ex.zh: 準軍事團體控制那個地區好幾年。

ex.en: The police have a paramilitary unit for emergencies.
ex.zh: 警方設有應付緊急狀況的準軍事單位。

paramilitary.en: organized like an army but not part of the official army

ex.en: You do your part and I'll do the rest.
ex.zh: 你做你的部分，剩下的我來做。

ex.en: Part of the report is missing.
ex.zh: 報告少了一部分。

part.en: one piece of a whole thing

ex.en: We are making spare parts in a car factory.
ex.zh: 我們在一家汽車工廠生產備用零件。

ex.en: We are waiting for a spare part.
ex.zh: 我們在等一個備用零件。

part.en: a piece that is used to make a machine

ex.en: Are you planning to take part in the meeting?
ex.zh: 你們打算參加會議嗎？

ex.en: Over 200 companies took part in the trade fair.
ex.zh: 超過兩百家公司參加了這場商展。

part.en: to join in an activity with others

ex.en: She played the part of a doctor.
ex.zh: 她飾演一名醫生。

ex.en: He had a small part in the movie.
ex.zh: 他在那部電影裡演一個小角色。

part.en: a person in a play or film that an actor plays

ex.en: They parted, never to see each other again.
ex.zh: 他們分開後就再也沒見過面。

ex.en: A fool and his money are soon parted.
ex.zh: 傻瓜很快就會把錢花光。

part.en: to separate or leave each other

ex.en: Have you still not finished paying for my bike?
ex.zh: 你還沒付完我腳踏車的錢嗎？

ex.en: Can I pay by credit card?
ex.zh: 我可以刷卡嗎？

pay.en: to give money for goods or services

ex.en: This job pays 10,000 yen a day.
ex.zh: 這份工作一天的報酬是一萬日圓。

ex.en: He would be paid a small amount of money.
ex.zh: 他會拿到一小筆錢。

pay.en: to give a worker money for their job

ex.en: You should pay more attention to what he says.
ex.zh: 你應該多注意他說的話。

ex.en: You should pay more attention to what you say.
ex.zh: 你應該多注意自己說的話。

pay.en: to watch or listen to something carefully

ex.en: The pay is good, but the hours are long.
ex.zh: 薪水不錯，但工時很長。

ex.en: She got a pay raise last month.
ex.zh: 她上個月加薪了。

pay.en: the money you get for doing your job

ex.en: All your hard work will pay off.
ex.zh: 你的努力都會有回報。

ex.en: Our marketing efforts finally paid off.
ex.zh: 我們的行銷努力終於有了成果。

pay.en: to bring a good result after effort

ex.en: Let's forget the past.
ex.zh: 讓過去的事過去吧。

ex.en: In the past, people wrote letters by hand.
ex.zh: 過去，人們都用手寫信。

past.en: the time before now, and what happened then

ex.en: We've been having strange weather the past few years.
ex.zh: 過去這幾年天氣一直很反常。

ex.en: I've learned a lot in the past three weeks.
ex.zh: 過去三週我學到了很多。

past.en: having happened before now, or during recent time

ex.en: His office is past the bank on your left.
ex.zh: 他的辦公室在過了銀行之後的左手邊。

ex.en: Walk past the bank and turn left.
ex.zh: 走過銀行後左轉。

ex.en: I have my supper at a quarter past seven.
ex.zh: 我七點十五分吃晚餐。

ex.en: I will sleep until it is half past eight.
ex.zh: 我要睡到八點半。

past.en: used when telling the time to show minutes after the hour

ex.en: Tom folded the paper before handing it to Mary.
ex.zh: 湯姆把紙折起來，再遞給瑪麗。

ex.en: Do you think that e-books will replace paper books?
ex.zh: 你覺得電子書會取代紙本書嗎？

ex.en: Can I have a piece of paper?
ex.zh: 可以給我一張紙嗎？

paper.en: thin flat material used for writing, printing or wrapping

ex.en: The papers that were in the safe are gone.
ex.zh: 放在保險箱裡的文件不見了。

ex.en: Would you please have a look at these papers?
ex.zh: 可以請你看一下這些文件嗎？

ex.en: Is there any special news in today's paper?
ex.zh: 今天的報紙有什麼特別的新聞嗎？

ex.en: I read the paper every morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上看報紙。

paper.en: a set of printed pages with the daily news

ex.en: I have to write a paper on climate change.
ex.zh: 我得寫一篇關於氣候變遷的報告。

ex.en: She presented a paper at the conference.
ex.zh: 她在研討會上發表了一篇論文。

paper.en: a long piece of writing on a subject, often for school or study

ex.en: I have no particular reason to do so.
ex.zh: 我沒有特別的理由這麼做。

ex.en: I would like to place particular emphasis on this point.
ex.zh: 我想特別強調這一點。

ex.en: Is there a particular time that works for you?
ex.zh: 有沒有哪個特定時間你比較方便？

ex.en: Laura is very particular about her clothes.
ex.zh: 蘿拉對衣服很講究。

ex.en: I'm not very particular about food.
ex.zh: 我對吃不太講究。

particular.en: hard to please and careful about details

ex.en: I want to emphasize this point in particular.
ex.zh: 我想特別強調這一點。

ex.en: I love Italian food, pasta in particular.
ex.zh: 我喜歡義大利菜，尤其是義大利麵。

ex.en: This new word is particularly important for us.
ex.zh: 這個新單字對我們特別重要。

ex.en: I love Nara, particularly in the fall.
ex.zh: 我很喜歡奈良，尤其是秋天的時候。

ex.en: The clothes at this boutique are particularly expensive.
ex.zh: 這家精品店的衣服特別貴。

particularly.en: to a higher degree than usual

ex.en: He spoke for ten minutes without a pause.
ex.zh: 他連續講了十分鐘都沒停頓。

ex.en: After a short pause, she continued her speech.
ex.zh: 短暫停頓後，她繼續演講。

pause.en: a short stop in an action or speech

ex.en: He paused to look at the poster.
ex.zh: 他停下來看海報。

ex.en: You can pause the video at any time.
ex.zh: 你可以隨時暫停影片。

pause.en: to stop for a short time before going on

ex.en: I don't like books with more than five hundred pages.
ex.zh: 我不喜歡超過五百頁的書。

ex.en: Tom ripped a page out of his sketch book.
ex.zh: 湯姆從素描本上撕下一頁。

ex.en: Please turn to page 25.
ex.zh: 請翻到第 25 頁。

page.en: one side of a sheet of paper in a book, or a screen on a website

ex.en: Please page Dr. Lee to the front desk.
ex.zh: 請廣播請李醫生到櫃台。

ex.en: I was paged at the airport.
ex.zh: 我在機場被廣播呼叫。

page.en: to call a person by a loud announcement or message

ex.en: She paged quickly through the magazine.
ex.zh: 她很快地翻閱了那本雜誌。

ex.en: I paged through the catalog during lunch.
ex.zh: 我午餐時翻閱了型錄。

page.en: to turn the sheets of a book or magazine and look at them quickly

ex.en: It is two miles from here to the park.
ex.zh: 從這裡到公園有兩英里。

ex.en: There were a lot of people in the park.
ex.zh: 公園裡有很多人。

park.en: a large public area with grass and trees

ex.en: He parked his car in front of the building.
ex.zh: 他把車停在大樓前面。

ex.en: Sorry, you can't park here.
ex.zh: 抱歉，你不能在這裡停車。

park.en: to leave a car in a place for a time

ex.en: She was asked to convince him to paint the house.
ex.zh: 有人要她去說服他油漆房子。

ex.en: The fence will be painted by Tom tomorrow.
ex.zh: 湯姆明天會油漆柵欄。

paint.en: to cover a surface with colored liquid

ex.en: He painted the picture which is on the wall.
ex.zh: 牆上那幅畫是他畫的。

ex.en: My sister likes to paint landscapes.
ex.zh: 我妹妹喜歡畫風景畫。

paint.en: to make a picture using colored liquids

ex.en: I've bought a new palette and a few paint brushes.
ex.zh: 我買了一個新調色盤和幾支畫筆。

ex.en: Be careful, the paint is still wet.
ex.zh: 小心，油漆還沒乾。

paint.en: a colored liquid put on surfaces or used to make pictures

ex.en: These eating patterns are a learned behavior.
ex.zh: 這些飲食模式是後天學來的行為。

ex.en: I noticed a pattern.
ex.zh: 我注意到一個規律。

ex.en: Sales follow a clear seasonal pattern.
ex.zh: 銷售額呈現明顯的季節性模式。

pattern.en: a regular way in which something happens or is done

ex.en: India ink produces an interesting pattern when used as a dye.
ex.zh: 墨汁拿來染色時會產生有趣的圖案。

ex.en: I like the pattern on your shirt.
ex.zh: 我喜歡你襯衫上的圖案。

pattern.en: a design of repeated shapes or lines

ex.en: I want to buy a pair of ski boots.
ex.zh: 我想買一雙滑雪靴。

ex.en: Mary has more than a hundred pairs of shoes.
ex.zh: 瑪麗有一百多雙鞋。

ex.en: There is a pair of scissors on the desk.
ex.zh: 書桌上有一把剪刀。

pair.en: two things of the same kind that are used together

ex.en: Everyone paired off and began dancing.
ex.zh: 大家兩兩配對，開始跳舞。

ex.en: New employees are paired with a mentor.
ex.zh: 新進員工會配一位導師。

ex.en: This wine pairs well with fish.
ex.zh: 這款酒很適合搭配魚。

pair.en: to put two people or things together

ex.en: Please work in pairs for this exercise.
ex.zh: 這個練習請兩人一組進行。

ex.en: The students practiced the dialogue in pairs.
ex.zh: 學生們兩人一組練習對話。

ex.en: The two men were business partners.
ex.zh: 這兩個男人是生意上的合夥人。

ex.en: Tom and I were business partners.
ex.zh: 湯姆和我以前是生意夥伴。

ex.en: They are our partners.
ex.zh: 他們是我們的合作夥伴。

partner.en: a person who owns or runs a business with someone else

ex.en: The teacher and her partner took the people attending the wedding to a park.
ex.zh: 老師和她的伴侶帶著參加婚禮的人去公園。

ex.en: You can bring your partner to the company party.
ex.zh: 你可以帶伴侶參加公司派對。

partner.en: a husband, wife or close friend, or someone you do an activity with

ex.en: We partnered with a local firm on this project.
ex.zh: 我們在這個專案上和一家本地公司合作。

ex.en: The two brands will partner to launch a new product.
ex.zh: 這兩個品牌將合作推出新產品。

partner.en: to work together with another person or company

ex.en: She's been having trouble with back pain for years.
ex.zh: 她背痛好幾年了。

ex.en: I have occasional pains in the stomach.
ex.zh: 我的胃偶爾會痛。

ex.en: The pain is here, right? That's a stomach ache.
ex.zh: 是這裡痛嗎？那是胃痛。

pain.en: the feeling you have in your body when it is hurt

ex.en: I cannot put up with this pain any more.
ex.zh: 我再也受不了這種痛苦了。

ex.en: Losing his job caused him a lot of pain.
ex.zh: 失業讓他非常痛苦。

pain.en: deep sadness or suffering in your mind

pain.zh: a pain (in the neck)：討厭的人或事

ex.en: Filling in these forms is such a pain.
ex.zh: 填這些表格真麻煩。

ex.en: My little brother can be a real pain.
ex.zh: 我弟弟有時真的很煩人。

pain.en: a person or thing that is very annoying

ex.en: The man is hiking on a narrow path.
ex.zh: 那個男人在一條狹窄的小路上健行。

ex.en: The path through the forest was completely covered in snow.
ex.zh: 穿過森林的小路完全被雪覆蓋了。

path.en: a narrow way for people to walk along

ex.en: Education is the path to happiness, peace, righteousness, and success.
ex.zh: 教育是通往幸福、和平、正義與成功的道路。

ex.en: Follow your own path and let people talk.
ex.zh: 走自己的路，讓別人去說吧。

path.en: a way of living or reaching a goal

ex.en: Have you finished packing yet?
ex.zh: 你行李收拾好了嗎？

ex.en: She helped me pack my suitcase.
ex.zh: 她幫我整理行李箱。

pack.en: to put things into a bag or box for a trip

ex.en: Kyoto is packed with people during the holiday season.
ex.zh: 假期期間京都人山人海。

ex.en: The train was packed with commuters.
ex.zh: 火車上擠滿了通勤族。

pack.en: to be completely full of people

ex.en: My father smokes a pack of cigarettes a day.
ex.zh: 我爸爸一天抽一包菸。

ex.en: I bought a pack of gum at the store.
ex.zh: 我在店裡買了一包口香糖。

pack.en: a small box or bag holding a set of things

ex.en: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.
ex.zh: 我不想參加典禮。

ex.en: She participates in many school activities.
ex.zh: 她在學校參加很多活動。

ex.en: Delegates from many countries participated in the conference.
ex.zh: 許多國家的代表參加了這場會議。

participate.en: to take part in an activity with others

ex.en: The captain is responsible for the safety of passengers.
ex.zh: 船長要為乘客的安全負責。

ex.en: The plane had five hundred passengers on board.
ex.zh: 飛機上載有五百名乘客。

ex.en: Passengers became nervous when the plane began to vibrate.
ex.zh: 飛機開始晃動時，乘客們都緊張了起來。

passenger.en: a person who travels in a vehicle but does not drive it

ex.en: Don't put your things in the passage.
ex.zh: 別把東西放在通道上。

ex.en: There's a secret passage on the left.
ex.zh: 左邊有一條祕密通道。

passage.en: a narrow way that leads from one place to another

ex.en: Translate the passage word for word.
ex.zh: 把這段文字逐字翻譯出來。

ex.en: Please read the passage.
ex.zh: 請讀一下這段文章。

ex.en: Read the passage and answer the questions.
ex.zh: 閱讀這篇短文並回答問題。

passage.en: a short part of a book or speech

ex.en: Memories fade with the passage of time.
ex.zh: 記憶會隨著時間流逝而淡去。

ex.en: The passage of time changed the town completely.
ex.zh: 時光流逝讓這個小鎮完全變了樣。

passage.en: the movement of time going by

ex.en: What you say is partly true.
ex.zh: 你說的有一部分是對的。

ex.en: We're partly responsible for that.
ex.zh: 我們對此要負一部分責任。

ex.en: It is partly cloudy today.
ex.zh: 今天晴時多雲。

partly.en: to some degree, but not completely

ex.en: Please don't walk so fast. I can't keep pace with you.
ex.zh: 請別走那麼快，我跟不上你。

ex.en: His pace was slower.
ex.zh: 他的腳步慢了下來。

ex.en: Technology is changing at a rapid pace.
ex.zh: 科技正快速變化。

pace.en: the speed at which you walk or do something

ex.en: He paced up and down the room.
ex.zh: 他在房間裡來回踱步。

ex.en: She paced nervously outside the office.
ex.zh: 她在辦公室外緊張地踱步。

pace.en: to walk back and forth, often because of worry

ex.en: The two streets run parallel to one another.
ex.zh: 這兩條街互相平行。

ex.en: The road is parallel to the river.
ex.zh: 這條路和河流平行。

parallel.en: running side by side with the same distance between

ex.en: There are many parallels between the two cases.
ex.zh: 這兩個案例有許多相似之處。

ex.en: Historians have drawn parallels between the two crises.
ex.zh: 歷史學家將這兩次危機相提並論。

parallel.en: a way in which two things are alike

ex.en: The road parallels the river.
ex.zh: 這條路與河流平行。

ex.en: The rise in sales parallels the growth of online shopping.
ex.zh: 銷售額的成長與網購的成長同步。

parallel.en: to run side by side with, or be similar to

ex.en: She has a passion for cake.
ex.zh: 她超愛吃蛋糕。

ex.en: She has a passion for music.
ex.zh: 她熱愛音樂。

ex.en: He talks about his work with real passion.
ex.zh: 他談起工作時充滿熱情。

passion.en: a very strong liking for something

ex.en: The poet expressed his burning passion for the woman he loved.
ex.zh: 詩人表達了他對所愛女子的熾熱激情。

ex.en: Their passion for each other never faded.
ex.zh: 他們對彼此的熱情從未消退。

passion.en: a very strong feeling of love or desire

ex.en: I love passion fruit juice.
ex.zh: 我很愛喝百香果汁。

ex.en: This cake is made with fresh passion fruit.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕是用新鮮百香果做的。

passion.en: a small round tropical fruit with a sweet sour juicy inside

partnership.zh: 合作關係、夥伴關係；合夥

ex.en: We have reached a partnership agreement.
ex.zh: 我們達成了合作協議。

ex.en: The two companies formed a partnership last year.
ex.zh: 這兩家公司去年建立了合作關係。

ex.en: We look forward to a long-term partnership with you.
ex.zh: 我們期待與您建立長期的合作關係。

partnership.en: a relationship in which people or companies work together

ex.en: Thank you very much for your participation!
ex.zh: 非常感謝您的參與！

ex.en: Class participation counts for 20% of the final grade.
ex.zh: 課堂參與占期末成績的 20%。

ex.en: We encourage the participation of all employees.
ex.zh: 我們鼓勵所有員工參與。

participation.en: the act of taking part in an activity

ex.en: This paragraph is vague.
ex.zh: 這個段落寫得很模糊。

ex.en: Please read the first paragraph carefully.
ex.zh: 請仔細閱讀第一段。

ex.en: Write a short paragraph about your hobby.
ex.zh: 寫一小段關於你嗜好的文字。

paragraph.en: a part of a text that starts on a new line and deals with one idea

ex.en: There was widespread panic after the earthquake.
ex.zh: 地震後，人們普遍陷入恐慌。

ex.en: Last night, I fell into a panic.
ex.zh: 昨晚我陷入一陣恐慌。

panic.en: a sudden strong feeling of fear that makes you unable to think clearly

ex.en: There's no need to panic. There's plenty of time.
ex.zh: 不用慌，時間還很多。

ex.en: Many investors panicked when the market fell.
ex.zh: 股市下跌時，許多投資人都慌了。

panic.en: to feel such sudden fear that you cannot think clearly

ex.en: Kate must be sick, for she looks pale.
ex.zh: 凱特臉色蒼白，一定是生病了。

ex.en: You look really pale. Are you all right?
ex.zh: 你臉色好蒼白，你還好嗎？

pale.en: having a face with less color than usual

ex.en: She was wearing a pale blue dress.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件淡藍色洋裝。

ex.en: The walls are painted pale yellow.
ex.zh: 牆壁漆成淡黃色。

pale.en: light in color, not strong or bright

ex.en: My problems pale in comparison to yours.
ex.zh: 我的問題跟你的比起來根本不算什麼。

ex.en: Last year's sales pale beside this year's results.
ex.zh: 去年的業績跟今年比起來相形見絀。

pale.en: to seem less important when compared with something else

ex.en: The internet created a new paradigm for business.
ex.zh: 網路為商業創造了新的模式。

ex.en: This discovery led to a paradigm shift in medicine.
ex.zh: 這項發現帶來了醫學上的典範轉移。

paradigm.en: a typical example or a model of how something is done

ex.en: This is a paradox.
ex.zh: 這是個矛盾。

ex.en: It's a paradox that more choices can make us less happy.
ex.zh: 選擇越多反而可能越不快樂，這真是矛盾。

ex.en: The paradox is that saving time often costs more money.
ex.zh: 矛盾的是，省時間往往要花更多錢。

paradox.en: a situation or statement that seems impossible because it has opposite parts

ex.en: Pardon me, do you speak English?
ex.zh: 不好意思，請問你會說英文嗎？

ex.en: Pardon me, what place is this?
ex.zh: 不好意思，請問這裡是哪裡？

ex.en: Pardon me, but that is my racket.
ex.zh: 不好意思，那是我的球拍。

pardon.en: used to say sorry or to get someone's attention politely

ex.en: I beg your pardon; I didn't quite catch your name.
ex.zh: 不好意思，可以再說一次嗎？我沒聽清楚你的名字。

ex.en: Pardon? Could you say that again?
ex.zh: 抱歉，你可以再說一次嗎？

pardon.en: used to ask someone politely to say something again

ex.en: Please pardon me for coming late.
ex.zh: 請原諒我遲到了。

ex.en: Please pardon my messy handwriting.
ex.zh: 請原諒我的字很潦草。

pardon.en: to forgive someone for a small mistake

ex.en: The president pardoned the prisoner.
ex.zh: 總統赦免了那名囚犯。

ex.en: He was pardoned after ten years in prison.
ex.zh: 他坐了十年牢之後獲得特赦。

pardon.en: to officially forgive a criminal so they are free from punishment

ex.en: This movie requires parental guidance.
ex.zh: 這部電影需要家長陪同觀看。

ex.en: Parental leave allows new parents to stay home with their baby.
ex.zh: 育嬰假讓新手爸媽能在家陪寶寶。

parental.en: related to a mother or father

ex.en: You should put this phrase in parentheses.
ex.zh: 你應該把這個片語放在括號裡。

ex.en: Write the area code in parentheses.
ex.zh: 把區碼寫在括號裡。

parenthesis.en: one of the curved marks that go around extra information in writing

ex.en: A narrow pathway leads to the beach.
ex.zh: 一條狹窄的小路通往海灘。

ex.en: The garden pathway is lined with flowers.
ex.zh: 花園小徑兩旁種滿了花。

pathway.en: a narrow way for people to walk along

ex.en: Education is a pathway to a better career.
ex.zh: 教育是通往更好職涯的途徑。

ex.en: The program offers a clear pathway to promotion.
ex.zh: 這個計畫提供明確的升遷管道。

pathway.en: a way of reaching a goal or result

ex.en: His paralysis is progressing, and soon he won't be able to get out of bed.
ex.zh: 他的癱瘓持續惡化，很快就沒辦法下床了。

ex.en: The accident left him with partial paralysis.
ex.zh: 那場意外讓他局部癱瘓。

paralysis.en: the loss of the ability to move part of the body

ex.en: The strike caused a complete paralysis of public transportation.
ex.zh: 罷工造成大眾運輸全面癱瘓。

ex.en: Too many choices can lead to decision paralysis.
ex.zh: 選擇太多可能會讓人無法做決定。

paralysis.en: a state in which nothing can move or work

ex.en: She writes to her pen pal in London twice a month.
ex.zh: 她每個月寫兩次信給住在倫敦的筆友。

ex.en: Old pal! Where are you working now?
ex.zh: 老朋友！你現在在哪裡工作？

ex.en: Tom and I have been pals since high school.
ex.zh: Tom 和我從高中就是好朋友。

ex.en: Have you finished packing yet?
ex.zh: 你行李收拾好了嗎？

ex.en: I was busy packing, because I was leaving for France in two days.
ex.zh: 我當時正忙著打包，因為兩天後就要去法國了。

ex.en: I always leave my packing until the last minute.
ex.zh: 我總是拖到最後一刻才收拾行李。

packing.en: the act of putting things into bags or boxes for a trip

ex.en: The price includes packing and shipping.
ex.zh: 價格包含包裝和運費。

ex.en: Use plenty of packing to protect the glasses.
ex.zh: 用大量填充材料保護這些玻璃杯。

packing.en: the materials used to wrap and protect goods

ex.en: The pasture has an area of 10 acres.
ex.zh: 這座牧場面積有十英畝。

ex.en: That pasture is ten acres.
ex.zh: 那座牧場有十英畝大。

pasture.en: a field covered with grass where farm animals eat

pasture.zh: greener pastures：更好的機會（常指換工作）

ex.en: After five years, he left for greener pastures.
ex.zh: 五年後，他離開去尋找更好的發展。

ex.en: Many staff are looking for greener pastures.
ex.zh: 許多員工正在尋找更好的機會。

pasture.en: a better situation, such as a new job

ex.en: You shouldn't talk back to your parents like that.
ex.zh: 你不應該對你父母那樣頂嘴。

ex.en: I wrote a letter to my parents at home.
ex.zh: 我寫了封信給家鄉的父母。

ex.en: A parent or teacher should bring home to children the pleasure of reading.
ex.zh: 家長或老師應該讓孩子體會閱讀的樂趣。

ex.en: He's the new CEO from the parent company in France.
ex.zh: 他是來自法國母公司的新任執行長。

ex.en: The parent company owns five smaller brands.
ex.zh: 母公司旗下擁有五個較小的品牌。

parent.en: a company that owns or controls other smaller companies

ex.en: The party has been put off until next Tuesday.
ex.zh: 派對延到下週二了。

ex.en: There appears to be a party in that house.
ex.zh: 那間房子裡好像在開派對。

party.en: a social event where people enjoy food, drink and music

ex.en: The organization is not connected with any political parties.

ex.zh: 一道低矮的石造女兒牆沿著屋頂邊緣延伸。

ex.en: He is a pathological liar who can't stop making up stories.
ex.zh: 他是個慣性說謊者，老是停不下來編故事。

ex.en: She has a pathological fear of heights.
ex.zh: 她對高處有病態的恐懼。

ex.en: The doctor ordered a pathological test of the tissue.
ex.zh: 醫生下令對這個組織做病理檢驗。

ex.en: The hospital has a pathological laboratory in the basement.
ex.zh: 醫院地下室有一間病理實驗室。

ex.en: A narrow passageway connects the kitchen to the garden.
ex.zh: 一條狹窄的通道把廚房連到花園。

ex.en: Please keep the passageway clear in case of fire.
ex.zh: 請保持通道暢通，以防火災。

pawn.zh: （西洋棋）兵；棋子般被利用的人

ex.en: He moved a pawn forward in the chess game.
ex.zh: 他在棋局中把一個兵往前移。

ex.en: She felt like a pawn in a game played by others.
ex.zh: 她覺得自己像是別人遊戲中的一顆棋子。

ex.en: He had to pawn his watch to pay the rent.
ex.zh: 他不得不典當手錶來付房租。

ex.en: She pawned her ring for some quick cash.
ex.zh: 她為了急用現金而典當了戒指。

ex.en: She sprinkled grated parmesan over the pasta.
ex.zh: 她在義大利麵上撒了磨碎的帕瑪森起司。

ex.en: Parmesan has a strong, salty flavor.
ex.zh: 帕瑪森起司的味道濃郁又帶鹹味。

ex.en: My paternal grandmother lives in a small village.
ex.zh: 我的奶奶（父親的母親）住在一個小村莊。

ex.en: He gave her some paternal advice about money.
ex.zh: 他給了她一些像父親般的理財建議。

ex.en: She felt a pang of guilt about missing the party.
ex.zh: 她因沒去參加派對而感到一陣愧疚。

ex.en: A sharp hunger pang reminded him he had skipped lunch.
ex.zh: 一陣強烈的飢餓感提醒他午餐沒吃。

ex.en: My grandmother made a patchwork quilt from old clothes.
ex.zh: 我奶奶用舊衣服做了一條拼布被。

ex.en: The bag is sewn from colorful patchwork pieces.
ex.zh: 這個袋子是用色彩繽紛的拼布縫成的。

ex.en: From the plane, the fields looked like a green patchwork.
ex.zh: 從飛機上看，田野像一塊綠色的拼布。

ex.en: The rules are a patchwork of old laws that don't fit together well.
ex.zh: 這些規定是由舊法律東拼西湊而成，彼此不太協調。

ex.en: The horses were grazing in the paddock behind the barn.
ex.zh: 馬匹在穀倉後面的圍場裡吃草。

ex.en: The farmer built a fence around the paddock.
ex.zh: 農夫在小牧場四周築了圍籬。

ex.en: As a pacifist, he refused to join the army.
ex.zh: 身為和平主義者，他拒絕從軍。

ex.en: The pacifist spoke at the rally about solving problems without war.
ex.zh: 那位和平主義者在集會上談到不靠戰爭解決問題。

ex.en: The city held a participatory meeting so residents could share ideas.
ex.zh: 市政府舉辦了參與式會議，讓居民表達想法。

ex.en: This class uses a participatory style of learning.
ex.zh: 這門課採用參與式的學習方式。

ex.en: From the top of the hill, we enjoyed a panorama of the whole city.
ex.zh: 從山頂上，我們欣賞了整座城市的全景。

ex.en: She took a panorama of the lake with her phone.
ex.zh: 她用手機拍了一張湖的全景照。

ex.en: She pared the apples before baking the pie.
ex.zh: 她在烤派之前先把蘋果削皮。

ex.en: The company pared its costs by closing two offices.
ex.zh: 公司關閉兩間辦公室來削減成本。

ex.en: Grandparents love to pamper their grandchildren.
ex.zh: 祖父母都愛寵孫子。

ex.en: I want to pamper myself with a long bath this weekend.
ex.zh: 這個週末我想泡個久一點的澡好好犒賞自己。

ex.en: We had breakfast at a small Parisian cafe.
ex.zh: 我們在一間小小的巴黎咖啡館吃了早餐。

ex.en: She dresses with a very Parisian sense of style.
ex.zh: 她的穿著帶有濃濃的巴黎風格。

ex.en: The Parisian gave us directions to the museum.
ex.zh: 那位巴黎人告訴我們去博物館怎麼走。

ex.en: Many Parisians take their holidays in August.
ex.zh: 許多巴黎人會在八月度假。

ex.en: The papacy has existed for many centuries.
ex.zh: 教皇制度已存在許多個世紀。

ex.en: He was elected to the papacy after a long meeting.
ex.zh: 他在漫長的會議後被選為教皇。

ex.en: Extreme partisanship makes it hard for lawmakers to agree.
ex.zh: 極端的黨派之爭讓議員們很難達成共識。

ex.en: Many voters are tired of the partisanship in the news.
ex.zh: 許多選民厭倦了新聞裡的黨派對立。

ex.en: The sofa has thick padding, so it is very comfortable.
ex.zh: 這張沙發有厚厚的填充物，所以非常舒適。

ex.en: Football players wear padding to protect their shoulders.
ex.zh: 美式足球球員穿著護墊來保護肩膀。

ex.en: Cut the padding and get to the point of your essay.
ex.zh: 刪掉廢話，直接切入你文章的重點。

ex.en: Most of the report was just padding to make it look longer.
ex.zh: 這份報告大部分只是為了讓它看起來更長的灌水內容。

ex.en: She zipped up her parka before going out into the snow.
ex.zh: 她出門走進雪地前拉上了派克大衣的拉鍊。

ex.en: A warm parka is a must for winter hiking.
ex.zh: 保暖的連帽厚外套是冬季健行的必備品。

ex.en: That story is patently untrue.
ex.zh: 那個說法顯然不是真的。

ex.en: The test was patently unfair to students who hadn't been told about it.
ex.zh: 這場考試對那些沒被告知的學生來說顯然不公平。

painstaking.zh: 一絲不苟的；煞費苦心的

ex.en: The restorers did painstaking work on the old painting.
ex.zh: 修復師對這幅老畫做了極其細心的工作。

ex.en: Writing a dictionary is a slow and painstaking job.
ex.zh: 編字典是一件緩慢又需要耐心細緻的工作。

patronising.zh: 以居高臨下的態度對待（patronize 的現在分詞）

ex.en: Stop patronising me; I understand the rules perfectly well.
ex.zh: 別再用那種高高在上的態度對我了，我完全懂規則。

ex.en: She was accused of patronising her younger coworkers.
ex.zh: 她被指責對年輕同事擺出居高臨下的態度。

painstakingly.zh: 煞費苦心地；一絲不苟地

ex.en: He painstakingly copied every line of the old map.
ex.zh: 他一絲不苟地描摹了舊地圖上的每一條線。

ex.en: The team painstakingly cleaned each piece of the ancient pot.
ex.zh: 團隊小心翼翼地清理那只古陶器的每一塊碎片。

ex.en: The vaccine was quick and almost painless.
ex.zh: 疫苗打得很快，幾乎不痛。

ex.en: Learning a language is never completely painless.
ex.zh: 學語言絕不會完全沒有痛苦。

ex.en: The court ordered a test to confirm paternity.
ex.zh: 法院下令做檢驗以確認父子關係。

ex.en: He took two weeks of paternity leave after his son was born.
ex.zh: 兒子出生後，他請了兩週的陪產假。

paying.zh: 付錢；支付（pay 的現在分詞）

ex.en: I am paying for dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 今晚晚餐我請客。

ex.en: He is still paying off his student loan.
ex.zh: 他還在償還就學貸款。

ex.en: The cafe lost many paying customers during the road work.
ex.zh: 道路施工期間，咖啡店流失了許多付費顧客。

ex.en: It is hard to find a paying job in this field.
ex.zh: 在這個領域很難找到有薪水的工作。

ex.en: He sat passively while others made the decision.
ex.zh: 其他人做決定時，他只是被動地坐著。

ex.en: Students learn less when they listen passively to lectures.
ex.zh: 學生被動地聽講時學到的比較少。

ex.en: Many Jewish families gather for a special meal at Passover.
ex.zh: 許多猶太家庭在逾越節聚在一起吃特別的晚餐。

ex.en: Passover is celebrated in the spring.
ex.zh: 逾越節在春天慶祝。

ex.en: The child filled a pail with sand at the beach.
ex.zh: 孩子在海灘上把桶子裝滿沙子。

ex.en: She carried a pail of water to the garden.
ex.zh: 她提了一桶水到花園。

ex.en: The pandemic changed the way many people work.
ex.zh: 這場大流行改變了許多人的工作方式。

ex.en: Scientists worked hard to control the pandemic.
ex.zh: 科學家努力控制這場大流行。

ex.en: It was a pandemic disease that spread across many countries.
ex.zh: 那是一種擴散到許多國家的全球大流行疾病。

ex.en: Doctors warned of a pandemic outbreak of flu.
ex.zh: 醫生警告流感可能全球大流行。

ex.en: The rocket carries a payload of scientific tools.
ex.zh: 火箭載著一批科學儀器。

ex.en: The truck's payload is limited to two tons.
ex.zh: 這輛卡車的載重限制為兩噸。

ex.en: I parked the car near the station.
ex.zh: 我把車停在車站附近。

ex.en: He parked outside the school and waited.
ex.zh: 他把車停在學校外面等著。

ex.en: A parked truck blocked the narrow street.
ex.zh: 一輛停著的卡車擋住了窄街。

ex.en: Don't walk between the parked cars.
ex.zh: 不要在停著的車子之間走動。

ex.en: Parenthood changed the way they spend their weekends.
ex.zh: 為人父母改變了他們週末的過法。

ex.en: She was not ready for the challenges of parenthood.
ex.zh: 她還沒準備好面對為人父母的挑戰。

ex.en: The parched ground cracked under the sun.
ex.zh: 乾透的土地在烈日下裂開。

ex.en: The farmers looked at the parched fields in despair.
ex.zh: 農夫們絕望地望著乾枯的田地。

ex.en: I'm parched after the long hike.
ex.zh: 走了那麼久的山路，我渴死了。

ex.en: Give me some water; I'm parched.
ex.zh: 給我一些水，我口渴得要命。

ex.en: A passer saw the smoke and called for help.
ex.zh: 一位路人看到濃煙，打電話求救。

ex.en: The street was empty, with not a passer in sight.
ex.zh: 街上空蕩蕩的，看不到半個路人。

ex.en: The soup was simple but quite palatable.
ex.zh: 這碗湯雖然簡單，卻相當可口。

ex.en: The company made the bad news more palatable by offering a bonus.
ex.zh: 公司用發獎金的方式讓壞消息比較容易被接受。

ex.en: A black panther moved silently through the dark forest.
ex.zh: 一隻黑豹在漆黑的森林中悄悄移動。

ex.en: The zoo's panther spends most of the day sleeping in a tree.
ex.zh: 動物園裡的豹一天大部分時間都在樹上睡覺。

ex.en: The panda spent the afternoon eating bamboo.
ex.zh: 那隻貓熊整個下午都在吃竹子。

ex.en: Many visitors line up to see the giant panda at the zoo.
ex.zh: 許多遊客排隊去動物園看大貓熊。

ex.en: Locals patronise the small bakery every morning.
ex.zh: 當地人每天早上都光顧那家小麵包店。

ex.en: Rich families used to patronise young artists.
ex.zh: 富有的家庭過去常贊助年輕藝術家。

patronise.zh: 以高人一等的態度對待

ex.en: Don't patronise me; I understand the problem.
ex.zh: 別用那種高高在上的態度對我，我懂這個問題。

ex.en: He patronised the new employees by explaining simple things slowly.
ex.zh: 他慢慢解釋簡單的事，把新進員工當小孩看待。

ex.en: His passivity at work made it hard for him to get promoted.
ex.zh: 他在工作上的被動態度讓他很難獲得升遷。

ex.en: The teacher worried about the students' passivity in class.
ex.zh: 老師擔心學生在課堂上太被動。

ex.en: Many scholars study how patriarchy has shaped history.
ex.zh: 許多學者研究父權制如何塑造歷史。

ex.en: In a patriarchy, men hold most of the power in families and society.
ex.zh: 在父權社會中，男性掌握家庭與社會的大部分權力。

ex.en: The city is protecting a large area of parkland near the river.
ex.zh: 市政府正在保護河邊一大片公園綠地。

ex.en: We walked through the open parkland with our dog.
ex.zh: 我們帶著狗走過開闊的公園綠地。

ex.en: He gave a pained smile when he heard the bad news.
ex.zh: 他聽到壞消息時，露出了痛苦的微笑。

ex.en: She had a pained look on her face after the argument.
ex.zh: 爭吵過後，她臉上露出受傷的神情。

ex.en: The library has dark wood panelling on every wall.
ex.zh: 圖書館每面牆都鋪著深色木壁板。

ex.en: They removed the old panelling to repair the wall behind it.
ex.zh: 他們拆掉舊的壁板，修補後面的牆。

ex.en: Sprinkle a little paprika on the potatoes before baking.
ex.zh: 烤馬鈴薯之前撒一點紅椒粉。

ex.en: The stew gets its red color from paprika.
ex.zh: 這道燉菜的紅色來自紅椒粉。

ex.en: The library has a beautiful panelled ceiling.
ex.zh: 這間圖書館有一個漂亮的嵌板天花板。

ex.en: We had dinner in a dark, panelled dining room.
ex.zh: 我們在一間深色木板牆的餐廳裡用餐。

ex.en: The paleontologist carefully brushed the dust off the fossil.
ex.zh: 古生物學家小心地刷掉化石上的灰塵。

ex.en: A young paleontologist found the dinosaur bones in the desert.
ex.zh: 一位年輕的古生物學家在沙漠中發現了恐龍骨骼。

ex.en: A partridge ran across the path ahead of us.
ex.zh: 一隻鷓鴣從我們前方的小路跑過。

ex.en: Partridges usually live on farmland and in open fields.
ex.zh: 鷓鴣通常棲息在農地和開闊的田野。

ex.en: The camping paraphernalia filled the whole trunk of the car.
ex.zh: 露營用的全套裝備塞滿了整個後車廂。

ex.en: He carried all his painting paraphernalia to the park.
ex.zh: 他把所有繪畫用具帶到公園。

ex.en: Cerebral palsy affects how a person moves and balances.
ex.zh: 腦性麻痺會影響一個人的動作與平衡。

ex.en: Bell's palsy can cause one side of the face to droop.
ex.zh: 貝爾氏麻痺可能使一側臉部下垂。

ex.en: Some politicians pander to voters instead of telling the truth.
ex.zh: 有些政客不說實話，只會迎合選民。

ex.en: The show was criticized for pandering to young viewers.
ex.zh: 這個節目因為一味迎合年輕觀眾而受到批評。

ex.en: In the story, a prince swaps clothes with a pauper.
ex.zh: 故事中，一位王子和一個窮人交換衣服。

ex.en: He was born rich but died a pauper.
ex.zh: 他生來富有，卻死於貧困。

ex.en: The hotel room has a panoramic view of the bay.
ex.zh: 這間飯店客房可以看到海灣的全景。

ex.en: I took a panoramic photo from the top of the hill.
ex.zh: 我在山頂拍了一張全景照片。

ex.en: The parson gave a short talk after the Sunday service.
ex.zh: 牧師在週日禮拜後做了簡短的演說。

ex.en: In the novel, the village parson is a kind old man.
ex.zh: 小說裡，村裡的牧師是個和藹的老人。

ex.en: Air filters trap particulate that causes breathing problems.
ex.zh: 空氣濾網會攔住造成呼吸問題的微粒。

ex.en: Factories must limit the particulate they release.
ex.zh: 工廠必須限制排放的微粒。

ex.en: Particulate pollution is high in the city today.
ex.zh: 今天城市裡的懸浮微粒汙染很嚴重。

ex.en: The mask blocks particulate matter in smoky air.
ex.zh: 口罩能擋住煙霧空氣中的微粒物質。

ex.en: Everyone was invited to partake in the celebration.
ex.zh: 大家都受邀參加慶祝活動。

ex.en: Guests may partake of the food on the table.
ex.zh: 賓客可以享用桌上的食物。

ex.en: The parliamentarian spoke for an hour about the new law.
ex.zh: 那位國會議員針對新法律談了一個小時。

ex.en: An experienced parliamentarian knows the rules of debate well.
ex.zh: 經驗豐富的議員很熟悉辯論的規則。

ex.en: The Pantheon in Rome is an ancient temple with a huge dome.
ex.zh: 羅馬的萬神殿是一座有巨大圓頂的古老神殿。

ex.en: Zeus was the king of the Greek pantheon.
ex.zh: 宙斯是希臘眾神之王。

ex.en: Packaged food is easy to carry on a trip.
ex.zh: 包裝好的食物很方便旅行時攜帶。

ex.en: The store sells packaged salads next to the fresh fruit.
ex.zh: 這家店把包裝好的沙拉擺在新鮮水果旁邊。

packaged.zh: 包裝（package 的過去式與過去分詞）

ex.en: The workers packaged the toys and sent them to the store.
ex.zh: 工人們把玩具包裝好，送到店裡。

ex.en: She carefully packaged the glasses before moving.
ex.zh: 搬家前，她小心地把玻璃杯包裝好。

paltry.zh: 微不足道的；少得可憐的

ex.en: He was paid a paltry sum for a full week of work.
ex.zh: 他做了整整一週，只拿到少得可憐的錢。

ex.en: It is a paltry excuse for being late again.
ex.zh: 這是個再次遲到的蹩腳藉口。

ex.en: Friday is payday, so we are going out to dinner.
ex.zh: 星期五是發薪日，所以我們要出去吃晚餐。

ex.en: He saves a little from every payday.
ex.zh: 他每個發薪日都會存下一點錢。

ex.en: The Panamanian coffee here is delicious.
ex.zh: 這裡的巴拿馬咖啡很好喝。

ex.en: She holds a Panamanian passport.
ex.zh: 她持有巴拿馬護照。

ex.en: My neighbor is a Panamanian who loves baseball.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居是個愛棒球的巴拿馬人。

ex.en: Many Panamanians work near the canal.
ex.zh: 許多巴拿馬人在運河附近工作。

ex.en: A parasitic worm lives inside the animal's body.
ex.zh: 一種寄生蟲棲息在動物的體內。

ex.en: Mistletoe is a parasitic plant that grows on trees.
ex.zh: 槲寄生是長在樹上的寄生植物。

ex.en: I had fresh papaya for breakfast.
ex.zh: 我早餐吃了新鮮的木瓜。

ex.en: A ripe papaya is soft and sweet.
ex.zh: 熟透的木瓜又軟又甜。

ex.en: She blended papaya with milk to make a drink.
ex.zh: 她把木瓜和牛奶打成飲料。

ex.en: We like to patronize the small bakery near our house.
ex.zh: 我們喜歡光顧住家附近的小麵包店。

ex.en: Locals patronize this market every weekend.
ex.zh: 當地人每個週末都會來這個市場消費。

patronize.zh: 以高人一等的態度對待

ex.en: Please don't patronize me; I understand the problem.
ex.zh: 請不要用那種高高在上的態度對我，我懂這個問題。

ex.en: The manager patronized the new staff and they felt insulted.
ex.zh: 經理對新進員工擺出高人一等的態度，讓他們覺得受到侮辱。

ex.en: The study had dark wood paneling on every wall.
ex.zh: 書房每面牆都鑲著深色木板。

ex.en: They replaced the old paneling with fresh paint.
ex.zh: 他們把舊的鑲板換成了新油漆。

ex.en: There is a paucity of good restaurants in this small town.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮很缺好餐廳。

ex.en: The report pointed out a paucity of clear evidence.
ex.zh: 報告指出明確的證據很少。

patronizing.zh: 高高在上的、居高臨下的

ex.en: I hate his patronizing tone when he explains things.
ex.zh: 我討厭他解釋事情時那種居高臨下的語氣。

ex.en: She gave me a patronizing smile after I asked the question.
ex.zh: 我問完問題後，她對我露出一個高傲的微笑。

ex.en: The patterning on the carpet is very detailed.
ex.zh: 這張地毯的圖案設計非常細緻。

ex.en: Scientists study the patterning of stripes on a zebra.
ex.zh: 科學家研究斑馬身上條紋的形成方式。

ex.en: Papua is a region on the island of New Guinea.
ex.zh: 巴布亞是新幾內亞島上的一個地區。

ex.en: Many unique birds live in the forests of Papua.
ex.zh: 許多特有的鳥類棲息在巴布亞的森林裡。

ex.en: In legal parlance, this is called a breach of contract.
ex.zh: 以法律用語來說，這叫違約。

ex.en: He explained the idea in everyday parlance.
ex.zh: 他用日常用語解釋這個想法。

ex.en: The paratrooper checked his parachute before the jump.
ex.zh: 傘兵在跳傘前檢查了他的降落傘。

ex.en: A paratrooper must train for months before the first jump.
ex.zh: 傘兵在第一次跳傘前必須訓練好幾個月。

ex.en: He was a pathfinder in the field of space research.
ex.zh: 他是太空研究領域的開拓者。

ex.en: The pathfinder walked ahead to mark a safe route.
ex.zh: 探路者走在前面標出一條安全的路線。

ex.en: The accident left him paralyzed from the waist down.
ex.zh: 那場意外讓他腰部以下癱瘓。

ex.en: She stood paralyzed with fear when the dog barked.
ex.zh: 狗吠叫時，她嚇得僵在原地。

ex.en: The pancreas helps the body control blood sugar.
ex.zh: 胰臟幫助身體控制血糖。

ex.en: The pancreas also makes enzymes that help digest food.
ex.zh: 胰臟也會分泌幫助消化食物的酵素。

ex.en: The company sells a patented device that saves water.
ex.zh: 這家公司販售一種取得專利的省水裝置。

ex.en: Their patented design cannot be copied by other makers.
ex.zh: 他們取得專利的設計不能被其他廠商仿製。

ex.en: The crowd panicked when the lights suddenly went out.
ex.zh: 燈光突然熄滅時，人群陷入恐慌。

ex.en: She panicked and forgot everything she had studied.
ex.zh: 她一慌張，把讀過的東西全忘光了。

ex.en: After the scandal, he became a pariah in the town.
ex.zh: 醜聞之後，他成了鎮上被人排擠的對象。

ex.en: No one wants to be treated like a social pariah.
ex.zh: 沒有人想被當成社會的棄兒。

ex.en: The old statue had a green patina.
ex.zh: 那座舊雕像上有一層綠色的銅鏽。

ex.en: The wooden table had a rich patina from years of use.
ex.zh: 這張木桌因多年使用而有一層溫潤的光澤。

parma.zh: 帕爾馬（義大利北部城市）

ex.en: Parma is a city in northern Italy.
ex.zh: 帕爾馬是義大利北部的一座城市。

ex.en: Parma is famous for its ham and cheese.
ex.zh: 帕爾馬以火腿和起司聞名。

ex.en: The parallelism between the two stories is easy to see.
ex.zh: 這兩個故事之間的相似之處很容易看出來。

ex.en: Good writing often uses parallelism to make sentences balanced.
ex.zh: 好的寫作常用排比讓句子顯得均衡。

ex.en: The particularity of each case makes a general rule difficult.
ex.zh: 每個案例的特殊性使得訂出通則很困難。

ex.en: She described the particularity of the local dialect.
ex.zh: 她描述了當地方言的獨特之處。

ex.en: The film is full of pathos and made many viewers cry.
ex.zh: 這部電影充滿哀傷的感染力，讓許多觀眾落淚。

ex.en: There was a touch of pathos in the old man's smile.
ex.zh: 老人的笑容裡帶著一絲淒涼。

ex.en: The writer uses pathos to make readers feel sympathy.
ex.zh: 作者用感傷的筆法讓讀者產生同情。

ex.en: Fossils from the Palaeozoic era were found in these rocks.
ex.zh: 這些岩石中發現了古生代的化石。

ex.en: Many Palaeozoic sea animals had hard shells.
ex.zh: 許多古生代的海洋動物有堅硬的殼。

parlay.zh: 把（本錢或機會）轉化成更大的收益

ex.en: She parlayed a small loan into a successful business.
ex.zh: 她把一小筆貸款滾成了一門成功的生意。

ex.en: He hopes to parlay his fame into a movie career.
ex.zh: 他希望能把名氣轉化成電影事業。

ex.en: The patient received a pacemaker to keep his heartbeat steady.
ex.zh: 病人裝了心律調節器來維持穩定的心跳。

ex.en: Her grandfather has had a pacemaker for five years.
ex.zh: 她祖父已經裝了五年心律調節器。

ex.en: The pacemaker led the first half of the marathon at a steady speed.
ex.zh: 配速員在馬拉松前半段以穩定的速度帶領大家。

ex.en: She followed the pacemaker to finish with her best time.
ex.zh: 她跟著配速員跑出了自己的最佳成績。

ex.en: The car's paintwork was scratched in the parking lot.
ex.zh: 那輛車的烤漆在停車場被刮傷了。

ex.en: We need to repair the paintwork on the front door.
ex.zh: 我們得修補前門的油漆。

ex.en: Students learn to parse sentences in grammar class.
ex.zh: 學生在文法課學習剖析句子結構。

ex.en: The program cannot parse a file with missing data.
ex.zh: 這個程式無法解析缺少資料的檔案。

ex.en: We drove along the parkway to enjoy the autumn leaves.
ex.zh: 我們沿著公園大道開車，欣賞秋天的樹葉。

ex.en: Trucks are not allowed on this parkway.
ex.zh: 卡車不能行駛這條林蔭大道。

ex.en: A patrolman stopped the car for speeding.
ex.zh: 一名巡警攔下了超速的車。

ex.en: The patrolman walked slowly down the quiet street.
ex.zh: 巡警沿著安靜的街道慢慢走。

ex.en: The mother sang softly to pacify the crying baby.
ex.zh: 母親輕聲唱歌來安撫哭鬧的寶寶。

ex.en: The manager tried to pacify the angry customers with a free coffee.
ex.zh: 經理試著用一杯免費咖啡來安撫憤怒的顧客。

ex.en: He felt panicky when he couldn't find his passport.
ex.zh: 他找不到護照時覺得很慌張。

ex.en: The panicky crowd rushed toward the exit.
ex.zh: 驚慌的群眾衝向出口。

ex.en: I fell asleep to the patter of rain on the roof.
ex.zh: 我聽著雨點輕拍屋頂的聲音睡著了。

ex.en: We heard the patter of small feet running down the hall.
ex.zh: 我們聽到小腳丫在走廊上快步跑過的啪嗒聲。

ex.en: Rain began to patter against the window.
ex.zh: 雨開始啪嗒啪嗒地打在窗戶上。

ex.en: The puppy pattered across the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 小狗啪嗒啪嗒地跑過廚房地板。

ex.en: She dipped the paintbrush into the blue paint.
ex.zh: 她把畫筆沾進藍色顏料裡。

ex.en: I need a wide paintbrush to paint the fence.
ex.zh: 我需要一支寬的油漆刷來刷籬笆。

ex.en: She is a paragon of patience and kindness.
ex.zh: 她是耐心與善良的典範。

ex.en: The teacher held him up as a paragon of hard work.
ex.zh: 老師把他當作勤奮的模範。

ex.en: The soldiers asked the padre to say a prayer.
ex.zh: 士兵們請神父做禱告。

ex.en: The padre visited the wounded every morning.
ex.zh: 那位隨軍神父每天早上探視傷兵。

panache.zh: 瀟灑的風采；炫耀的氣勢

ex.en: She handled the difficult situation with great panache.
ex.zh: 她以十足的風采處理了這個困難的局面。

ex.en: The singer performed with style and panache.
ex.zh: 那位歌手表演得既有風格又有氣勢。

ex.en: She put pansies in a pot on the balcony.
ex.zh: 她在陽台的花盆裡種了三色堇。

ex.en: The pansy has small, colorful petals.
ex.zh: 三色堇有小巧又多彩的花瓣。

ex.en: The hotel was cheap, and the food was passable.
ex.zh: 那間旅館很便宜，食物也還過得去。

ex.en: His French is passable, but he still makes mistakes.
ex.zh: 他的法文還算過得去，但仍會犯錯。

ex.en: After the repairs, the mountain road was passable again.
ex.zh: 修好之後，那條山路又可以通行了。

ex.en: The river was barely passable after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨過後，這條河幾乎無法通行。

ex.en: The boy's parentage was a mystery to everyone.
ex.zh: 沒有人知道那個男孩的出身。

ex.en: She is proud of her mixed parentage.
ex.zh: 她為自己混合的血統感到驕傲。

ex.en: The paymaster handed each worker an envelope on Friday.
ex.zh: 出納員在週五把薪水袋交給每位工人。

ex.en: The army paymaster kept careful records of every payment.
ex.zh: 軍中的發薪官把每筆支出都仔細記錄下來。

ex.en: The teacher gave the paired students a task to complete together.
ex.zh: 老師給兩人一組的學生一項要共同完成的作業。

ex.en: The shop sells paired earrings in a small box.
ex.zh: 這家店賣盒裝成對的耳環。

ex.en: The accident left him paralysed from the waist down.
ex.zh: 那場意外讓他腰部以下癱瘓。

ex.en: She stood paralysed with fear as the dog ran toward her.
ex.zh: 狗朝她跑來時，她嚇得動彈不得。

ex.en: The company has a paternalistic attitude toward its workers.
ex.zh: 這家公司對員工抱持家長式的態度。

ex.en: Many people find paternalistic rules annoying.
ex.zh: 許多人覺得這種管得太多的規定令人反感。

ex.en: After a few weeks, the excitement of the new job began to pall.
ex.zh: 幾週後，新工作帶來的興奮感開始消退。

ex.en: Even the best food can pall if you eat it every day.
ex.zh: 就算是最好吃的食物，天天吃也會膩。

pall.zh: 陰沉的籠罩物；靈柩罩布

ex.en: A pall of smoke hung over the city.
ex.zh: 一層煙霧籠罩在城市上空。

ex.en: The news cast a pall over the whole celebration.
ex.zh: 這則消息使整場慶祝蒙上陰影。

ex.en: He secured the gate with a heavy padlock.
ex.zh: 他用一把沉重的掛鎖鎖住大門。

ex.en: I forgot the combination to my bike padlock.
ex.zh: 我忘了腳踏車掛鎖的密碼。

ex.en: Pandemonium broke out when the fire alarm went off.
ex.zh: 火警響起時，現場一片大亂。

ex.en: The classroom was in pandemonium after the teacher left.
ex.zh: 老師離開後，教室裡亂成一團。

ex.en: The patrician lived in a grand villa outside Rome.
ex.zh: 那位貴族住在羅馬郊外的一棟豪華別墅。

ex.en: Patricians once held most of the power in the city.
ex.zh: 貴族們曾經掌握這座城市大部分的權力。

ex.en: She spoke with a patrician accent.
ex.zh: 她說話帶著貴族式的口音。

ex.en: The family had a patrician air about it.
ex.zh: 這個家族帶著一股貴族氣派。

ex.en: The sick child had a pallid face.
ex.zh: 那個生病的孩子臉色蒼白。

ex.en: A pallid sun appeared behind the winter clouds.
ex.zh: 一輪黯淡的太陽出現在冬季雲層後面。

ex.en: Our paediatrician told us the baby was growing well.
ex.zh: 我們的兒科醫師說寶寶長得很好。

ex.en: She trained for years to become a paediatrician.
ex.zh: 她受訓多年才成為兒科醫師。

ex.en: The paediatrician checked his throat and listened to his chest.
ex.zh: 兒科醫師檢查了他的喉嚨，並聽了他的胸部。

ex.en: Those baggy jeans are completely passe now.
ex.zh: 那種寬鬆牛仔褲現在已經完全過時了。

ex.en: He thinks writing letters by hand is passe.
ex.zh: 他覺得手寫信件已經過時了。

ex.en: The case is a paradigmatic example of good teamwork.
ex.zh: 這個案例是良好團隊合作的典範。

ex.en: Her career is paradigmatic of the new generation of engineers.
ex.zh: 她的職涯是新一代工程師的典型代表。

palmetto.zh: 棕櫚（美洲的一種矮棕櫚）

ex.en: A palmetto grows well in warm coastal areas.
ex.zh: 棕櫚在溫暖的沿海地區長得很好。

ex.en: The palmetto leaves were used to weave baskets.
ex.zh: 棕櫚葉被用來編籃子。

ex.en: The festival featured a panoply of colorful costumes.
ex.zh: 慶典展示了琳瑯滿目的繽紛服裝。

ex.en: The shop offers a panoply of teas from around the world.
ex.zh: 這家店供應來自世界各地的各式茶葉。

ex.en: The puppy whined pathetically at the door.
ex.zh: 小狗在門口可憐兮兮地哀鳴。

ex.en: The team played pathetically and lost by a large margin.
ex.zh: 球隊表現糟透了，大比數落敗。

ex.en: She carried a lace parasol to keep off the sun.
ex.zh: 她撐著一把蕾絲陽傘遮太陽。

ex.en: We sat under a big parasol at the beach.
ex.zh: 我們在海灘坐在一把大陽傘下。

ex.en: The dentist removed the tooth painlessly.
ex.zh: 牙醫無痛地拔掉了那顆牙。

ex.en: The new app lets you learn words almost painlessly.
ex.zh: 這個新應用程式讓你幾乎毫不費力地學單字。

parsnip.zh: 歐洲防風草（一種根莖蔬菜）

ex.en: She roasted carrots and parsnips with honey for dinner.
ex.zh: 她晚餐用蜂蜜烤了紅蘿蔔和防風草根。

ex.en: A parsnip looks like a pale carrot but tastes sweeter.
ex.zh: 防風草根看起來像淺色的紅蘿蔔，但吃起來更甜。

pandora.zh: 潘朵拉（希臘神話中的女子）

ex.en: In Greek myth, Pandora opened a jar that released troubles into the world.
ex.zh: 在希臘神話中，潘朵拉打開了一個罐子，把災禍放進了世界。

ex.en: The story of Pandora is often told to explain why bad things exist.
ex.zh: 潘朵拉的故事常被用來解釋為什麼世上有壞事。

ex.en: She wore a navy pantsuit to the interview.
ex.zh: 她穿著一套海軍藍的褲裝去面試。

ex.en: A pantsuit is comfortable and looks professional.
ex.zh: 褲裝套裝既舒適又顯得專業。

ex.en: His grandfather passed away peacefully last winter.
ex.zh: 他的爺爺去年冬天安詳地過世了。

ex.en: She was very sad when her old teacher passed away.
ex.zh: 她的老師過世時，她非常難過。

ex.en: The famous singer passed away at the age of ninety.
ex.zh: 那位知名歌手以九十歲高齡辭世。

pass away.en: to die, said in a gentle and polite way

ex.en: He almost passed out in the hot room.
ex.zh: 他在悶熱的房間裡差點暈倒。

ex.en: Several runners passed out because of the heat.
ex.zh: 好幾位跑者因為高溫而昏倒了。

ex.en: She felt dizzy and then passed out on the floor.
ex.zh: 她覺得頭暈，接著就昏倒在地上。

pass out.en: to lose consciousness for a short time

ex.en: The teacher passed out the homework at the end of class.
ex.zh: 老師在下課時把作業發下去。

ex.en: Volunteers passed out flyers in front of the station.
ex.zh: 志工在車站前發傳單。

ex.en: Please pass out these cups to everyone.
ex.zh: 請把這些杯子分給每個人。

pass out.en: to give something to each person

ex.en: She finally paid off her student loan last year.
ex.zh: 她去年終於還清了學貸。

ex.en: We plan to pay off the car in two years.
ex.zh: 我們打算兩年內付清車貸。

ex.en: He worked extra jobs to pay off his debts.
ex.zh: 他兼了額外的工作來還清債務。

pay off.en: to pay all the money you owe

ex.en: All your hard work will pay off someday.
ex.zh: 你所有的努力總有一天會有回報。

ex.en: Her risky plan paid off in the end.
ex.zh: 她那個冒險的計畫最後有了成果。

ex.en: Studying every day really paid off during the exam.
ex.zh: 每天讀書在考試時真的派上用場了。

pay off.en: to bring a good result after effort

ex.en: The company paid off the witness to stay silent.
ex.zh: 公司收買證人讓他保持沉默。

ex.en: He tried to pay off the officer, but it didn't work.
ex.zh: 他試圖賄賂警官，但沒有成功。

ex.en: They paid off several officials to get the deal.
ex.zh: 他們收買了好幾位官員來拿下這筆交易。

pay off.en: to give someone money to keep quiet or do something dishonest

ex.en: Please pay attention to what the teacher is saying.
ex.zh: 請專心聽老師說的話。

ex.en: He didn't pay attention and missed the turn.
ex.zh: 他沒專心，結果錯過了轉彎處。

ex.en: You need to pay attention when you cross the road.
ex.zh: 過馬路時你必須專心注意。

pay attention.en: to watch or listen carefully to something
